name: SaturnNav
tagline: Low-stimulus nav — short cues, long quiet, limited understanding on purpose
mission: Bikers, gas, lithium ion, acoustic, hell even unicyclers. Especially unicyclers. The road is already a lot — SaturnNav doesn't pile on stimuli. Sparse voice, narrow scope, so you can process what's in front of you.
changelog: v0.1.0 — Preferential routing, casual speaker layer, rider profiles, basin editor
